## Context / Problem
LLM failure classification is duplicated: the context-length heuristic is byte-identical in `src/rebar/llm/failure.py:152` and `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py:316-329` (comment at `failure.py:146` says "stay in sync"); the stop-reason→message map exists in `src/rebar/llm/structured.py:622,632` and `failure.py:355`; the retryable→exit-code mapping is hand-composed in four CLI verbs (`src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py:46-98,162,236-247,341`), `src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:27-34,239`, and `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py:656-686`. Bug `injurious-definable-badger` (content-filter denial reported as "too large") hid exactly at the seam where one caller composed `message_for(...)` without the `finish_reason`.

## Approach
Make `failure.py` the only classifier: `sizing.py` imports `_CONTEXT_LEN_HINTS`; `structured.py` derives its messages from `message_for`; add `failure.exit_code_for(outcome_or_coverage) -> int` and `failure.mcp_payload_for(...)` used by the four verbs, MCP, and `close_precheck`. Guard: the context-length hint strings and the `content_filter` message literal appear only in `failure.py`.


## Guard construction
Follow the guard-test construction rule in the parent epic `airborne-wellloved-kingfisher`: owner module exempt, match the constituent conjunction or AST shape named in Approach (or the definition count where no distinctive atom exists), `# <construct>-ok: <reason>` escape marker, and behaviour pinned only by the named existing tests.

## Scope
`src/rebar/llm/failure.py`, `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/sizing.py`, `src/rebar/llm/structured.py`, `src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py`, `src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py`, `src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py`, `tests/unit/llm/test_failure_exit_codes.py` (new).

## Testing
Table test: every (exception, finish_reason) pair in the existing fixtures yields the same class, message, exit code, and MCP payload as today across all six callers. Edge: `content_filter` with and without `finish_reason` yields the content-filter message on every caller. Pinning: `tests/unit/test_llm_failure*.py`, `tests/unit/test_close_gate_bound_remedy_db1c.py`, `tests/unit/workflow/test_completion_recovery_contract.py` pass unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `grep -rn "maximum context length" src/rebar` returns one file; checked by the grep and the guard test.
- [ ] Exit codes 11/1/2 for every fixture outcome are identical across the six callers; checked by the table test.
- [ ] Pinning suites pass unchanged; checked by `pytest`.
